personality_one_liner: A calming, bright, and classy health app using soft creams and teals to move away from clinical tech vibes into a personal wellness space.

styling_suggestions.radius_and_shadow: Use radius lg (20px) with shadow tier 1 (subtle) to make the white cards float gently on the cream background.
styling_suggestions.fonts: Keep PlusJakartaSans for text (excellent readable utility). Replace SpaceGrotesk with 'Outfit' or use 'PlusJakartaSans' for both, as SpaceGrotesk is slightly too brutalist/techy for a classy, soft health app.
